params.name: input
params.label: Input
params.description: The node whose geometry is measured; its bounding box is added as detail attributes and the geometry passed on.

params.name: prefix
params.label: Prefix
params.description: The start of the four detail attribute names written: <prefix>_min, _max, _size and _center. Empty writes nothing.

params.name: group
params.label: Group
params.description: A point group whose points alone are measured. Empty measures every point.
